column1: # The cut-sweep cases each STORE milestone runs (sync.py NATIVE_STORE_MILESTONE, tools/corpus --selection
# store-milestone): a share of every family, never a family whole. One row each, tab-separated: key (a prefix
# naming a family's cases), N, and a note naming the ruling. Every swept STORE case falls under exactly one row.
# A family's runs are its cases' in name order, each case's cuts in order; share T is those at positions
# i % N == T - 1. A milestone takes, per row, a share not yet passed in the family's current cycle (chosen by the
# checked commit) and records it with its verdict in the git common directory's hirsel-store-milestones.tsv, so N
# passing milestones run every run of the family once. N here is sized to 40 CPU-h a milestone in all (orchestrator,
# 2026-11-12): `tools/corpus --native --selection store-milestone --plan` prints its CPU-h, each family's cycle in
# milestones and how many milestones full coverage takes; re-print it rather than re-plan by hand when costs move.
